content: Astro's Fonts API is stable/unflagged in current docs (Astro 6/7 era) but in the project's pinned astro@5.18.2, font config still lives under experimental.fonts (verified in installed node_modules/astro/dist/core/config/schemas). Manual Fontsource CSS import + explicit ?url woff2 import for preload avoids the experimental flag entirely and is the safer choice for this phase.
